card.text: Explore Mentor in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Jupiter Trojan in the L5 trailing cloud. Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Mentor · DAMIT 4281 convex shape
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 126.288 km effective diameter (fit ±1.642 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). An alternative pole solution remains in the archive. Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation; grid marks unavailable imagery.

elevation.title: Mentor · source-model radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 63.144 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
